title: Lodge parades and Lanoix's 1922 initiation
summary: The band played at initiations; the picture may date from the day he was initiated in June 1922.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: Did you all have many parades with that group?
Oh, yeah. Every time they had initiation there, that's what that was. Initiation there. Yeah, there I am. See? But I'm not...
I'm not back there yet. You don't have a uniform on them, I guess. I have a strong hand.
